currency.resident: USD (stated as figures without currency symbol on Resident page, but structurally identical to Full Board/Ground tables which are explicitly USD; treat with caution)
currency.confidenceNote: [Unverified] The Resident Rate table (page 3) does not restate 'US Dollars' the way the Non-Residents section does on page 1 - given the magnitude of the numbers (e.g. 26,000 for a double) these read as KES, not USD, despite no explicit currency label on that page. Treat resident figures as KES pending confirmation.

notes: Family room = per room, max 4 adults, two twins + shared sitting area.
Deluxe category has doubles only (no twins); Superior category has both twin and double beds.
3rd bed supplement: 75% of the per-person sharing rate. Single room rate is 75% of the double room rate.

ANOMALY: Resident rate table's Family figure for 23/12/2026-2/1/2027 season reads 760000, wildly inconsistent with every other Family figure in that table (52000-112000 range) - almost certainly a typo (missing decimal / extra zero, likely meant 76000). Flagged, not corrected.

nonResidentFullBoardRates_perNight.unit: Lodge/Tents, Double/Single per person; Family per room (max 4 pax)

nonResidentGroundPackageRates_perNight.includes: Full board accommodation, local airstrip transfers, shared game drive
excludes: Park entry fee and flight cost

residentRates_possiblyKES_unconfirmed.confidenceNote: [Unverified currency] See top-level currency note. [Unverified figure] Family 760000 for lodge, festive season - almost certainly a typo for 76000 (see anomalies note).

childPolicy.raw: Free under 3yrs sharing with adult (max 2/room). 3-11yrs sharing with two adults: 50% of adult rate (max 2/room). Two children 3-11 in own private room: 75% of double room rate. One child sharing with one adult: full adult sharing rate. Three children in a room: 75% of double room rate plus 50% of adult rate. 12+ considered adults.

gameDriveAndActivityRates.amount: US$30pp (or US$25 per T&Cs page, inconsistent - see confidenceNote)
gameDriveAndActivityRates.confidenceNote: Two different extra-lunch figures appear in the source: US$30pp (activities page) vs US$25pp (T&Cs page). Both quoted verbatim.

policies.deposit: 30% non-refundable deposit for peak season bookings; otherwise full payment 30 days prior to arrival unless agent has approved credit
policies.cancellationShoulderPeak: 0-30 days: 100% of contract rate; 31-45 days: 50%; 45-60 days: 25%
policies.groupPolicy: 1 free pax per 15 paying clients, max 2 free per group, must be requested at booking
policies.roomsPolicy: Max 3 single rooms per group at single rate; additional singles charged at double room rate
